mentions.note: Jefferies upgraded on a denim/90s-nostalgia trend, a $400M buyback (~10% of market cap), and an unexploited Helly Hansen growth brand.
Selling the Lee brand for up to $1B funds a large buyback; Wrangler plays denim strength and Helly Hansen is an underappreciated growth driver — cheap at 15x earnings with a ~3% yield.
